source: Independent centres of domestication with the windows in which each package's staple appears there; a hearth outside every centre is a miss, a centre without a hearth by its latest is a miss (W8). Windows are archaeological checks, not simulation rails. A centre may carry its own radiusDegrees where the source describes a belt rather than a point (Harlan 1971's Sahelian non-centre).
